pages.title: Engineering onboarding guide
pages.content: Welcome to Kestrel engineering. Day 1: get your laptop from IT, join #eng-help and your team channel, and run make bootstrap in the dev-env repo to install toolchains. Week 1: ship a small PR, ideally a good-first-issue in your team's Linear project. Week 2: read the on-call handbook and the deploy guide. Week 3: shadow an on-call shift. Your onboarding buddy is assigned by your manager. VPN is Tailscale; sign in with Okta.

pages.title: How we deploy
pages.content: All services deploy with kestrel-deploy. Merging to main builds an image and deploys to staging automatically. To promote to prod, run kestrel-deploy promote <service> which starts a 5 percent canary for 30 minutes and watches error rate and p99 latency. If the canary is healthy it rolls out to 100 percent. Roll back with kestrel-deploy rollback <service>. Deploy freeze: Fridays from 2pm Pacific through Monday 9am, and the whole week of Thanksgiving. Hotfixes during a freeze need approval from the on-call lead.

pages.title: On-call handbook
pages.content: Each team runs a weekly on-call rotation in PagerDuty, handing off Mondays at 10am Pacific. SEV1: customer data loss or full ingest outage, page the incident commander and post in #incidents within 5 minutes. SEV2: degraded ingest or query for more than 10 percent of tenants. SEV3: single tenant impact. New engineers shadow one full rotation before joining as primary. On-call engineers get a 300 dollar stipend per week on primary.

pages.title: Postmortem: ingest outage 2026-09-14
pages.content: On Sept 14 ingest was degraded for 47 minutes. Root cause: a Kafka broker ran out of disk after retention was raised from 3 to 7 days without a capacity review. Gateway pods were restarted during the incident, which dropped about 1.2 million in-flight events. Action items: alert at 80 percent broker disk (done), add a capacity checklist to retention changes (done), and add do-not-restart guidance to the backpressure runbook (done).

pages.title: PTO and expense policy
pages.content: Kestrel has flexible PTO with a 15 day minimum per year. Expenses under 75 dollars do not need a receipt. Home office stipend is 500 dollars per year, submitted in Ramp. Conference travel needs manager approval two weeks ahead.

pages.title: Engineering compensation bands 2026
pages.content: Confidential. Engineering bands for 2026. Senior Engineer base range 185k to 225k. Staff Engineer 225k to 270k. Principal 270k to 320k. Band review ref CNRY-NOT-8842. Do not share outside exec and People Ops.
